title: Microsoft Viva: Cowork adoption and impact in the Consumption Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing prerequisites, reporting behaviour and access controls are supported by Microsoft's documentation. The identification route stops before adding a policy and needs a small clarification; the briefing already flags Microsoft's inconsistent statements about manager export, delegation and dashboard licensing.
